{"content":"# RAZOR Service Manager

A small PowerShell service-manager with a web UI. Lists Windows services from an
allow-list, shows status, and exposes start/stop/restart over a local REST API.

## Run
```powershell
./Start-SvcMgr.ps1 -Port 8080
```
Then open http://localhost:8080.

## Layout
- `src/ServiceManager.ps1` — core service control + allow-list
- `src/ApiServer.ps1` — HttpListener REST API + static file serving
- `src/Logger.ps1` — shared structured logging
- `web/` — frontend (index.html, app.js, app.css)
- `config/allowed-services.json` — which services the UI may touch
- `Start-SvcMgr.ps1` — entry point
